item.title: Sotto 0.3.9
item.description:
• Deleting History while Sotto is tidying up old dictations can no longer trip over it, and a Yesterday recap written at the moment you delete that day's text is thrown away instead of saved.
  • If Sotto can't read History, Yesterday keeps trying and keeps its last recap, instead of saying there were no dictations.
  • Going back to a day in Yesterday and then away again can no longer show the wrong day, and Writing… no longer gets stuck without a button.
  • Quitting while a Voice Note is still being saved now always waits for it to finish.
  • The line under newly typed text picks light or dark more reliably when Appearance is on Auto.
  • Small fixes and tidying under the hood.
